topic: React Routing, Forms, and API Integration
learningObjectives: Create multi-page navigation using client-side routing concepts.
Build controlled forms and manage form submissions.
Connect React interfaces to backend APIs and display responses.

activities.title: Routing Architecture
activities.instruction: Click each route to see how it maps to a React view.

content.concept: Client-side routing maps URL paths to React components and allows navigation between views without performing a complete browser page reload.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Maps to the application's home page.
Maps to an About component or page.

activities.title: Controlled Form Builder
activities.instruction: Build the flow of a controlled React form.

content.concept: A controlled input gets its current value from React state and updates that state when the user changes the input.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: API Integration Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a React API request and response cycle.

content.concept: Frontend API integration typically involves sending a request, waiting for the response, processing the returned data, updating state, and rendering the result.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Response State Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate UI state for each API situation.

content.concept: A robust API-connected interface should represent loading, successful responses, validation failures, and server errors appropriately.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Request is still running → Show a loading state
Request is still running → Show the final data immediately
config.answer: Request is still running → Show a loading state
